intro: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is a parliamentary democracy with the British monarch as head of state.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Parliament has one chamber. In the 2025 election the opposition New Democratic Party won, and Godwin Friday became prime minister, ending Ralph Gonsalves's long rule.

chapters.title: World role
text: In 2020 it became the smallest country ever elected to the UN Security Council.
